fact: Ecofin Agency reports that the Guinean government launched the drafting of a National Data Governance Strategy on 19 June 2026, led by the National Directorate of Information Technology and the Digital Economy (DNTIEN).

The UN Economic Commission for Africa reports that national engagements in Conakry on 16-19 June 2026 (an assessment mission consulting 27 institutions, then workshops of 48 and 53 participants) were aimed at developing Guinea's National Data Governance Strategy; the final workshop reviewed preliminary findings and set priorities for the strategy, which is still to be written.

Guinea's Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Innovation states that on 19 June 2026 its minister opened a stakeholder workshop to draft the National Data Governance Strategy, carried by the DNTIEN; it calls the strategy a future one and gives no adoption date.
